name: Roquefort
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as aged cheeses are naturally low in lactose. Strong flavor means smaller portions are typically used.
preparationTips: Store wrapped in parchment paper in refrigerator to maintain proper moisture
Bring to room temperature 30 minutes before serving for best flavor
Crumble over salads or melt into sauces for intense flavor
Pair with low-FODMAP fruits like grapes or strawberries
